The prophet Joel was a prophet who saw not only his own time but all the way to the final judgment after the real end, when human history itself is over. He saw the coming of the Holy Spirit at Pentecost, he saw the whole earth covered with blood and fire and pillars of smoke at the last time, and after that he saw the judgment with a sharp sickle and the final judgment where people are tried in the LORD's valley of decision. He was an amazing prophet.
